context: Mature open-grown European beech (Fagus sylvatica) in parkland or a field edge; single-stemmed, healthy, leaf-on; not a copper, weeping or fastigiate cultivar, not a forest-grown stand tree, not a hedge.

required_capabilities.rationale: Capability assessment 2026-09-25 (host). The beech needs wood on every axis, an entire blade and an alternate petiole, all expressed. Its Troll's-model limbs (pitch by height, ragged reach) are missing rows, not named capabilities: fn-61. See packet/capability.json.
